heroText: Take care of your loved ones and everything that matters to you, keep your property under constant surveillance while you work or while on vacation.
featureTitle: Security and peace of mind in an eco-friendly package
featureText: Residential security solutions for completely wireless cameras connected by compact solar panel.
featureCard1Text: With a 600 lumen strobe light and a powerful 90dB siren directly from your phone to ward off unwanted guests.
featureCard2Text: Onboard advanced technology only alerts you when a person comes into view instead of pets or swaying trees.
featureCard3Text: Speak directly to anyone approaching via two-way audio, even if you're away from home.
